vulnerable-bank.summary: Making the owner variable immutable removes a costly storage write on deployment and eliminates SLOADs on each call that reads it. Replacing revert strings with custom errors cuts down runtime revert data, saving significant gas per call. Minor tweaks like caching balances and using unchecked arithmetic further trim per‑call costs.

optimizations.title: owner immutable
optimizations.description: owner is set once in the constructor and never changes; declaring it immutable stores it in code instead of storage, saving the deployment SSTORE and all future SLOADs.

optimizations.title: custom errors for require messages
optimizations.description: Replace string revert messages with custom errors to avoid storing and returning long strings, reducing gas on each revert path.

optimizations.title: cache balance in withdraw
optimizations.description: Read balances[msg.sender] once into a local variable and reuse it, eliminating a second SLOAD inside withdraw.

optimizations.title: unchecked subtraction in withdraw
optimizations.description: After the balance check, subtracting amount can be done in an unchecked block, saving a few gas units per call.

risks.description: If the caller reenters during the external call, the cached balance (bal) is stale and the unchecked subtraction uses the old value, allowing the caller to withdraw twice the intended amount.

gas-heavy.summary: Caching the sender balance in batchTransfer and computing total rewards via multiplication in distributeRewards remove repeated storage reads and per‑iteration arithmetic, giving the largest gas reductions. Making owner immutable and switching to calldata / external functions further cuts deployment and call costs.

optimizations.title: Cache sender balance in batchTransfer
optimizations.description: Reads balances[msg.sender] once before the loop, updates a local variable, and writes back after the loop, removing two SLOADs and one SSTORE per iteration.

optimizations.title: Cache holders length and compute totalReward via multiplication in distributeRewards
optimizations.description: Avoids reading array length each iteration and eliminates per‑iteration addition to totalReward.

optimizations.title: Make owner immutable
optimizations.description: Declaring owner immutable reduces storage reads and saves deployment gas.

optimizations.title: Use calldata for batchTransfer parameters
optimizations.description: Parameters are only read, so calldata avoids copying to memory.

optimizations.title: Replace require string with custom error in batchTransfer
optimizations.description: Custom errors are cheaper than string revert data.

optimizations.title: Replace require string with custom error in mint
optimizations.description: Custom error cheaper than string revert data.

optimizations.title: Make batchTransfer external
optimizations.description: Changing visibility to external saves calldata copying overhead.

optimizations.title: Make distributeRewards external
optimizations.description: External visibility saves a few gas per call.

optimizations.title: Make mint external
optimizations.description: External visibility saves a few gas per call.

optimizations.title: Use unchecked loop increments
optimizations.description: Removes overflow checks on i++ when bounds are safe.

risks.description: When the sender includes themselves in the to array, the rewrite deducts the amount but does not credit it back, decreasing the sender's balance, unlike the original which leaves the balance unchanged.
The loop index i is incremented inside an unchecked block; if to.length equals type(uint256).max the increment wraps to 0 and the loop never terminates, whereas the original would revert on overflow.
Adding rewardPerHolder to each holder's balance is performed inside an unchecked block, so if a holder's balance is near uint256.max the addition wraps instead of reverting as in the original.

staking-pool.summary: Making the owner immutable removes a storage read on every onlyOwner call, and replacing string require messages with custom errors cuts revert data costs. Caching frequently accessed storage values in withdraw further trims gas per call.

optimizations.title: owner immutable
optimizations.description: owner is set once in the constructor and never changes; declaring it immutable eliminates the SLOAD in the onlyOwner modifier.

optimizations.title: custom errors instead of require strings
optimizations.description: Using custom errors for access control and stake checks removes the cost of storing and loading string literals on revert.

optimizations.title: cache staked read in withdraw
optimizations.description: Read staked[msg.sender] once into a local variable and reuse it, saving a warm SLOAD.

optimizations.title: cache feeBps read in withdraw
optimizations.description: Store feeBps in a local variable before computing fee to avoid an extra SLOAD.
